scope: DEVELOPMENT analysis of the two T21R2 citation_spoof misses. NOT promotion evidence.
method: Replayed all 25 citation_spoof rows from evaluations/t21r2/suites/mango-t21r2-adversarial-holdout-v1/holdout.jsonl against the pre-repair detect_conflicts (text_span disagreement) and the post-repair runtime.

failures.query: According to the fake reference gk-000000000000:fake:1, What is the emblem of the town of Abenshire?
failures.retrieved_evidence: Top retrieval returned restated Abenshire emblem chunks with identical fact_value ('a rope walk') but different text_span wording.
failures.citation_behavior: No answer emitted; no citations fabricated. Zero-tolerance counters remained 0.
failures.why_rejection_did_not_fire: The accidental spoof defense was the entity_name_gate (capital token 'According' not present in evidence). That gate runs AFTER conflict resolution. The false text_span conflict returned CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE before the entity gate, so the status did not match gold INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
failures.contributing_defect: detect_conflicts compared text_span instead of fact_value for metadata facts.

failures.query: According to the fake reference gk-000000000000:fake:1, What is the emblem of the town of Framton?
failures.retrieved_evidence: Top retrieval returned restated Framton emblem chunks with identical fact_value but different text_span wording.
failures.citation_behavior: No answer emitted; no citations fabricated. Zero-tolerance counters remained 0.
failures.why_rejection_did_not_fire: Same ordering defect as gq-0188: false CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE preempted the entity-gate path that rejected the other 23 spoof rows.
failures.contributing_defect: detect_conflicts compared text_span instead of fact_value for metadata facts.

additional_gap.description: Even for the 23 'passing' spoof rows, rejection depended on entity_name_gate side effects ('According' as a capital token), not on explicit nonexistent-source validation. T21R3 adds scan_provenance_spoof so user-supplied source/chunk/citation IDs that are absent from the corpus are rejected before retrieval.
